requirements.description: Save a copy of the pre-existing _available_shells contents before the test clears it.
Clear _available_shells for the duration of the test.
Restore the saved shells after the test so other tests aren't affected.
Implement this as a pytest fixture with yield for setup and teardown, as the reviewer suggested.

label.evidence: tests/test_shell_completion.py:349-355 (the _restore_available_shells fixture), :358, :378, :404 (applied to all three tests)
label.notes: Author added a yield fixture (349-355) that copies _available_shells, clears it, yields, then clears and restores the copy; applied via usefixtures to all shell-registration tests, and the in-test .clear() calls are removed. Extra assertions and a new test (test_add_completion_class_with_name) were added but not requested. Teardown after yield runs even if the test fails, so isolation holds.
